name: Libra — Remind sellers of receipts about to expire

parameters.query:
-- Libra auto-expires a receipt nobody reviews (timeout_pending_verification_hours).
-- One row per seller with the orders that expire in the next 24 h; a daily run
-- therefore reminds about each order once.
select s.email as seller_email,
       coalesce(s.display_name, s.email) as seller_name,
       json_agg(json_build_object(
         'id', o.id,
         'buyer', coalesce(b.display_name, b.email),
         'total', o.total,
         'currency', o.currency,
         'transfer_number', o.transfer_number,
         'hours_left', greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from o.expires_at - now()) / 3600))
       ) order by o.expires_at) as orders
from public.orders o
join public.user_profiles s on s.id = o.seller_id
join public.user_profiles b on b.id = o.user_id
where o.payment_status = 'pending_verification'
  and o.expires_at > now()
  and o.expires_at <= now() + interval '24 hours'
group by s.id;

-- Retention for the receipt-check audit log (12 months, see libra-db/receipt_checks.sql).
select public.purge_integration_receipt_checks() as purged;
